htdemucs.description: Hybrid Transformer Demucs — 4 stems, CPU-only build (slow on long tracks)

pedalboard-chain.description: Pedalboard DSP mastering chain — preset-based EQ + compression + limiting (pedalboard 0.9.20, GPL v3)

librosa-analyze.description: librosa MIR analysis — BPM, key, loudness, duration, spectral features (librosa 0.10.2, ISC)

sox-transform.description: SoX-based DSP transform chain — gain, EQ, compressor, reverb, pitch, tempo (pysox 1.4.1, BSD-3-Clause)

fx-chain.description: Generic effects chain — full pedalboard catalog (Compressor, Reverb, Chorus, Delay, Distortion, PitchShift, filters, ...) as an ordered chain of {type, params}

midi-compose.description: JSON-to-MIDI transcoder — emit a Standard MIDI File from a tracks+notes spec (mido 1.3.3, MIT)

midi-render.description: MIDI-to-audio synthesis via fluidsynth + FluidR3_GM SoundFont (GM patches 0–127 plus drum kit on channel 10)

silence-detect.description: ffmpeg silencedetect filter — locate silent ranges + optional auto-trim

ffmpeg-render.description: ffmpeg-based audio visualisations — static spectrogram/waveform PNGs + animated video (showspectrum/showwaves/showcqt/showfreqs/showvolume/avectorscope/aphasemeter/ahistogram)

audio-fingerprint.description: Chromaprint audio fingerprint via fpcalc — recording identity hash for dedup / lookup

uvr-dereverb.description: De-reverb via BS-Roformer — removes room reverb from recordings

uvr-deecho.description: De-echo via VR Architecture — removes echo

uvr-denoise.description: AI de-noise via MelBand Roformer (SDR 28) — removes broadband background noise

uvr-karaoke.description: Karaoke — remove lead vocals, keep backing track (MelBand Roformer)

uvr-vocal-bsr.description: High-quality vocal/instrumental via BS-Roformer (SDR 13) — better quality than Demucs on many sources

basic-pitch.description: Polyphonic audio-to-MIDI transcription via Spotify basic-pitch

deepfilter.description: Neural speech and vocal enhancement via DeepFilterNet DF3

chord-detect.description: Chord and key detection via librosa Krumhansl-Schmuckler + chroma template matching

silero-vad.description: Voice activity detection via silero-vad — speech/non-speech segments with timestamps

pyannote.description: Speaker diarization via pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1 — who spoke when (requires HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN)

stretch.description: Time-stretch + pitch-shift via librosa phase vocoder — independent tempo factor and semitone offset, all audio formats

ast-tag.description: Audio tagging via Audio Spectrogram Transformer — top-K AudioSet class labels with confidence scores (requires HF model cache)

clap-embed.description: 512-dim audio embeddings via LAION CLAP — semantic audio search; optional text query returns cosine similarity (requires HF model cache)

hpss.description: Harmonic/percussive source separation via librosa HPSS median filter — returns harmonic (tonal) + percussive (transient) stems as a ZIP

noise-reduce.description: Spectral noise reduction via noisereduce — stationary (constant hum/hiss) and non-stationary (adaptive) modes, no GPU required

metadata.description: Read and write audio file tags (ID3, Vorbis, FLAC) via mutagen
